title: Remove profileImage: 'TODO' literal — make MemberCreate.profileImage nullable
objective: Stop sending the literal string 'TODO' to the backend as a new member's profileImage URL. Make MemberCreate.profileImage nullable, change the call site in AuthRepository._registerMember to pass null (or omit the field), and remove the 'TODO' sentinel.
description: AuthRepository._registerMember (lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_repository.dart, lines 264-270) builds MemberCreate with profileImage: 'TODO' as a stand-in until real avatar upload is wired. MemberCreate (lib/data/services/api/members/create/member_create.dart, lines 12-18) declares `required String profileImage`. The fix changes the field to `String? profileImage`, removes the 'TODO' literal from the call site, and either passes `profileImage: null` or omits the field. The .freezed.dart and .g.dart generated files are regenerated by build_runner — do NOT hand-edit them.

reference_files.reason: REWRITE the @freezed factory — change `required String profileImage` to `String? profileImage`.
REWRITE the _registerMember method body — change `profileImage: 'TODO'` to either omit the field or pass null. Also delete the `//TO-DO` comment that this subtask closes.
DO NOT hand-edit. Run `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` after changing member_create.dart to regenerate this file.

fix_shape.member_create_factory: Change `required String profileImage,` to `String? profileImage,` (drop the `required` keyword). The rest of the factory is unchanged.
fix_shape.auth_repository_call_site: Either omit `profileImage` entirely from the MemberCreate constructor call, or write `profileImage: null`. The `//TO-DO` comment on the same line is deleted because this subtask closes it. If omitting, leave a one-line comment `// profileImage is set later when the user uploads an avatar.` for context.
fix_shape.regeneration: After the source edit, run `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` from the repo root. This regenerates member_create.freezed.dart and member_create.g.dart so that _MemberCreate.profileImage becomes `String?` and _MemberCreateFromJson tolerates the field being absent.

acceptance_criteria: MemberCreate factory declares `String? profileImage` (nullable, not required)
AuthRepository._registerMember no longer contains the literal string 'TODO' as the profileImage value
build_runner regenerates member_create.freezed.dart and member_create.g.dart with the new nullable type
flutter analyze lib/ returns no errors after regeneration
No other call site of MemberCreate(...) in lib/ passes profileImage: 'TODO' — verified by `rg -n 'TODO' lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_repository.dart` returning zero matches
The `_registerMember` method's signature and return type are unchanged

grep_evidence: rg -n "profileImage: 'TODO'" lib/ must return zero matches
rg -n 'String\? profileImage' lib/data/services/api/members/create/member_create.dart must return at least one match
validation.build_runner_check: After `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs`, the diff in member_create.freezed.dart shows `final String? profileImage;` (or equivalent).

no_op_outside_scope: Do not touch other @freezed entities (members_entity.dart already has String? profileImage, no change needed). Do not change the MemberUpdate file. Do not hand-edit the .freezed.dart or .g.dart files.
